item.title: Former Virginia House Member Charles Poindexter Dies at 83
item.description: A former member of the Virginia House of Delegates died on Wednesday. According to the office of Representative Morgan Griffith, former Delegate Charles Poindexter died at age 83. Poindexter served in the 9th District seat from 2008-2022.
